spec_case: DESIGN.md §7.3 (M1-D2's own documented divergence: Turkish dotless/dotted I under IGNORECASE)
description: CPython folds i/I/ı(U+0131)/İ(U+0130) together under IGNORECASE (confirmed directly against _sre.unicode_tolower plus re._casefix._EXTRA_CASES); fancy-regex's own Unicode case folding keeps the Turkish dotless 'ı' apart from plain ASCII 'I' -- both engines succeed, electricity just doesn't match here. Pinned rather than left silently different.
